requirements.expectation: Human principal, provider, provider Bot, public visibility and caller channel binding are created through original business APIs before any ingress.
Group-target caller binding and caller execution_mode on an existing group binding are both rejected; the default-mode group binding is accepted.
Missing credential, blank credential, empty sender and missing ingress key are rejected with 422/401 and never reach the provider queue.
With pause_dispatch enabled, queued caller messages from two distinct humans remain queued and are not dispatched early.
After dispatch resumes, caller_context subject and caller_execution_token are delivered per request with strict per-human isolation and never copied into message content.
Binding downgrade to default blocks credential inheritance for new ingress while already accepted queued work still delivers.
Provider webhook switched to /sse still receives the caller execution token per request and the streamed run converges to completed.
BCS restart loses the in-memory caller credential cache while the durable queue survives; the queued caller delivery fails closed instead of falling back to provider identity.
SQLite dump and every .log file under the story directory are free of raw caller tokens.

story_markers: Caller HTTP/queue/provider E2E: {http_assertions} HTTP assertions passed
